name: item-tracker
description: Orient, record, and audit a project that tracks work as one markdown file per item under items/, where each file's status: field is the source of truth and TODO.md / DONE.md are generated views. Six skills: /inititems creates the store, /whereitems orients, /additem files one, /updateitems records a session, /verifyitems audits statuses against the real code, /planning-items-review audits the whole project.
